test_inputs.explanation: The agent navigated to URLs containing a base64-encoded filter (e.g. YXR0cmlidXRlX2NvZGU9Y29sb3ImZnJvbnRlbmRfbGFiZWw9Q29sb3ImaXNfZ2xvYmFsPTE=), which decodes to 'attribute_code=color&frontend_label=Color&is_global=1' — giving attribute_code='color', frontend_label='Color', and is_global=1 (mapped to scope_value 'Global'). The base_url is taken from the repeated admin URL visited. The agent did not consistently perform an Add New action, so click_add_new is false.
